# Persipica

> Persipica Pulse measures how AI assistants and shopping agents recommend a brand and its products, by kind of shopper, keeps the evidence behind every result, and turns the gaps into fixes it checks on the next scan. It is a cloud web app at pulse.persipica.com, made by Persipica in London.

Pulse is built first for online retailers and consumer brands, and also works for B2B software and services companies and the agencies that run several brands.

## What Pulse measures

- Assistants: choose from seven for each scan: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Grok, each using its own live web search, plus Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode as they appear in Google search. Scans start with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Every result says which assistant and which method it came from.
- Scans: A scan covers one brand. By default it asks 27 questions (9 to 45 can be set), three times each on every chat assistant and once on Google AI Overviews and AI Mode; with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini that is 243 answers. It counts as one scan however many assistants or audiences it includes. Shopping agent runs have their own allowance: 300 a month on Professional and 1,500 on Business.
- Visibility: how often answers mention and cite the brand, by assistant and against competitors, with share of voice, position, the likely range and the sample size of every rate.
- Audiences: simulated shoppers the brand describes (for example, a student on a budget or a parent buying for growing kids). Pulse asks questions in each one's voice, with follow-ups, and reports how often each audience is recommended the brand and which competitor it hears about instead. Audiences are simulated; every attribute is labelled as client data, a public signal or an assumption.
- Products and prices: with a catalogue imported from a Shopify store, a Google Merchant Center feed or a CSV, Pulse shows which products the answers name, the prices they quote against the catalogue, and the stores they send shoppers to.
- Shopping agents: agents get buying tasks; Pulse records whether they find the store, shortlist its products and pick them, compared with competitors, and why they chose someone else.
- Readiness: live checks on whether agents and AI crawlers can read the site (product data, structured markup, feeds, robots rules), and AI crawler visits from imported server logs.
- Prompts and demand: the questions people ask AI in the category, ranked by opportunity, optionally weighted with Google Search Console, Semrush or Ahrefs data.
- Competitors and sources: who is recommended instead, alerts when that changes, and the third-party sites the answers cite, split into owned, earned, community and review.
- Accuracy: wrong prices or stock, confusion with similarly named companies, and cited sources that don't support the claim.

## What Pulse does with it

- Actions: a to-do list of fixes suggested from the scans plus the team's own, with owners, status and each action's measured lift on the next scan.
- Content fixes: rewrites, FAQs and comparison pages drafted from the answers where the brand was missed, published to WordPress, Webflow, Contentful or Sanity, or sent anywhere with a webhook.
- Reports: a report per scan, summaries across scans, an executive view, impact on visits, conversions and revenue from imported GA4 and Search Console data, benchmarks, and branded share links.
- Alerts by email and Slack; scheduled scans; team roles, single sign-on and SCIM; a security log; an API and an MCP server.

## Pricing

- Free, £0: 1 brand, 10 scans a month, 1 team member, measured on ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. No card needed; sign up at https://pulse.persipica.com/login?mode=register.
- Starter, £99 a month: 1 brand, 50 scans a month, up to 3 team members. Visibility, audiences, products, evidence and content fixes.
- Professional, £299 a month: 3 brands, 200 scans a month, up to 10 team members. Adds shopping agents (300 runs a month), shopping visibility and prompt demand.
- Business, £599 a month: 10 brands, 1,000 scans a month, up to 15 team members. Adds 1,500 agent runs a month, actions with measured lift, readiness and AI crawler visits, impact reporting and client workspaces.
- Enterprise, custom: unlimited brands, scans and team members; reports under your own brand; single sign-on and SCIM; dedicated support.
